description: The plot illustrates the "Massive Activation of baseline" by representing four different metrics across layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with tick marks every 5 units. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks every 200 units. The "attn_output" metric is represented by a blue dashed line that starts at 0, remains near 0 until layer 21, rises to approximately 200 at layer 22, and ends at roughly 150 at layer 23. The "attn_residual" metric is shown as an orange dotted line that starts at 0, jumps to approximately 1400 at layer 5, increases to about 1480 at layer 7, remains steady until layer 12, increases to roughly 1580 at layer 14, remains steady until layer 21, drops to approximately 100 at layer 22, and ends at about 400 at layer 23. The "ffn_output" metric is depicted by a green dash-dot line that starts at 0, spikes to approximately 1400 at layer 5, drops to near 0 at layer 6, spikes to about 1000 at layer 13, drops to near 0 at layer 14, spikes to approximately 1400 at layer 21, drops to roughly 400 at layer 22, and ends at about 600 at layer 23. The "ffn_residual" metric is represented by a red solid line that starts at 0, jumps to approximately 1400 at layer 5, increases to about 1480 at layer 7, remains steady until layer 12, increases to roughly 1580 at layer 14, remains steady until layer 21, drops to approximately 400 at layer 22, and ends at about 800 at layer 23.
